summary: Venmo has added a receipt scanning feature that makes it easy for users split bills by item.
content: Venmo has rolled out a new receipt scanning feature designed to simplify how users split bills. The update allows customers to scan physical or digital receipts directly within the app, automatically itemizing the costs. This new tool aims to remove the hassle of manual calculations when friends share expenses, making group payments faster and more accurate.

Europe’s single market still has borders
summary:
how a business can localise its financial operations in a new market, without rebuilding them every time. 
The post Europe’s single market still has borders appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: Despite the European Union's single market, businesses expanding across borders still face significant friction in their financial operations. Companies often need to rebuild their financial infrastructure from scratch for each new market they enter. Experts highlight that navigating different local regulations, banking systems, and compliance requirements remains a complex challenge for growing firms within the region.

title: FCA AI guidance: What lenders need to know about oversight, resilience and customer outcomes
content: The Financial Conduct Authority has issued new artificial intelligence guidance focusing on how lenders should manage oversight, resilience, and customer outcomes. As financial institutions increasingly adopt automated technologies, regulatory scrutiny continues to grow. Lenders must ensure their AI systems remain robust, transparent, and aligned with consumer protection standards to maintain market integrity and trust.

title: Mojaloop powers the launch of Guinea's NimbaPay
summary: The Mojaloop Foundation, a nonprofit advancing financial inclusion through open-source interoperable, instant payment systems, today announced that its technology has been implemented in Guinea to power NimbaPay, the country’s national Inclusive Instant Payment System (IIPS).
content: The Mojaloop Foundation has announced that its open-source technology is now powering NimbaPay, Guinea's new national Inclusive Instant Payment System. This implementation aims to advance financial inclusion and enable interoperable, instant digital payments across the country.
